User Story: As an editor, I want to upload a CSV file with MO data, so I can see the dashboard from a fresh source.
Expected Behavior: Click "Загрузить CSV" triggers hidden #csvFile input. On file change: parseCSV runs, DashboardPhase1.showLoadingState() shows skeletons, renderMOSDashboard renders KPI/signals/table/charts. Status: "Загружен CSV: <name>". CSV must contain headers: Наименование МО, План на год, Общий итог, Динамика с прошлой недели, Прошли колоноскопию, Выявлено ЗНО C18-C21, Нет отклонений, Есть отклонения.
Test Method: Manual: upload tests/fixtures or any valid CSV. Vitest: tests/csvParser.test.js
Errors Found: BUG-004 (Minor UX): re-selecting the same CSV file did not fire change event because input.value retained the previous path.
Fix Applied: Reset input.value to '' after reader.readAsText in src/pages/editor.js change handler.
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; reading the file twice in a row now re-renders the dashboard.

User Story: As an editor, I want to pick an archived report from the dropdown and load it, so I can review/edit a previous snapshot.
Expected Behavior: Select #archiveSelect option then click "Загрузить выбранный архив" (or just change select). gasAdapter calls getArchivedReportWithPrevious. Dashboard re-renders with deltas vs previous report; doneText/plansText/period populated.
Test Method: Manual: requires GAS deployment. Vitest: tests/archiveHelpers.test.js
Errors Found: No errors found in code review.

User Story: As an editor, I want to save the current report (data+texts+period) to the archive, so the team can compare it later.
Expected Behavior: Click "Сохранить в архив". gasAdapter calls saveReportToArchive with {mosData, doneText, plansText, period}. After success: status message, archive list reloaded, weeksTrend cache invalidated.

User Story: As an editor, I want to refresh the archive dropdown, so I see newly saved reports without reloading the page.
Expected Behavior: Click circular refresh button. loadArchiveList re-fetches. Status shows "✅ Загружено N архивных отчётов".

User Story: As an editor, I want my typed period to show on the dashboard immediately, so the export reflects the right window.
Expected Behavior: Typing in #periodInput fires input listener → syncPeriodToDashboard → updates #periodDisplayText.
Test Method: Manual: type and observe period block update.
Errors Found: BUG-003 (HIGH/Security): periodInput value injected via innerHTML allowed XSS — typing '' executed.
Fix Applied: Switched #periodDisplayText and #nextWeekPeriodDisplay writes from innerHTML to textContent in editor.js (both live editor and exported HTML template).
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; period block now renders raw text without script execution.

User Story: As an editor, I want to type "Сделано" content with markup and see it on the dashboard, so the report carries my notes.
Expected Behavior: #doneTextInput input event → syncTextsToDashboard → renderHtmlContent (sanitized: b/strong/a/ul/li/br only, safe href) → #doneTextDisplay. Date stamp under it shows current date in ru-RU.
Test Method: Manual: type plain + with tags; verify sanitization. Vitest: tests/sanitize.test.js.
Errors Found: No errors found. Sanitizer covers <script>/onerror/javascript: vectors per existing tests.

User Story: As an editor, I want to type "Планы" content and see it on the dashboard with the next-week period.
Expected Behavior: #plansTextInput input event → syncTextsToDashboard → #plansTextDisplay (sanitized). #nextWeekPeriodDisplay shows getNextWeekPeriod().display.

User Story: As an editor, I want to wrap selected text with a link, so I can add references quickly.
Expected Behavior: Toolbar "Вставить ссылку" calls wrapWithLink(textareaId). If no selection: alert "Выделите текст". Else prompt URL. On confirm: selection wrapped as text; syncTextsToDashboard runs.
Errors Found: No errors found. Sanitizer downstream blocks javascript: hrefs.

User Story: As an editor, I want to wrap selected text with bold, so I can emphasize key items.
Expected Behavior: Toolbar "Жирный" → wrapWithBold. No selection → alert. Else wraps with …; syncTextsToDashboard.

User Story: As an editor, I want to insert a bullet line break, so I can build a list quickly.
Expected Behavior: Toolbar "Список" → insertListItem inserts "\n• " at caret; syncTextsToDashboard.

User Story: As an editor, I want to download the rendered dashboard as a standalone HTML file, so I can share it offline.
Expected Behavior: Click "Сохранить как HTML". Requires currentMOSData. Clones #dashboardContent, fetches UiIcons + UiPhase2 + UiTokens + Phase1+2 bundles, embeds Chart.js + Datalabels via CDN, embeds JSON of mos+weeks, includes icon SVG sprite + icon() shim. Triggers <a download="oncoscreen_report_<ISO>.html">. Status: "HTML-файл сохранён ✅".
Test Method: Manual: load CSV, click save, open downloaded file in browser.
Errors Found: BUG-001 (CRITICAL): exported HTML called icon('calendar') in its tail <script>, but the icon function was never defined in the export's scope (bundled inside DashboardPhase1 closure). ReferenceError halted the entire init script, leaving the export blank. BUG-007 (Visual): SVG icon sprite was never copied into the export, so even working markup showed empty icon slots.
Fix Applied: Added inline icon() shim mirroring src/lib/icons.js into the exportHtmlHead <script>. Added fetch('UiIcons.html') (with DOM fallback that finds the live <svg> sprite) and injected the sprite at the top of <body> before #dashboardContent.
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; build emits a fresh EditorPage.html; tail script executes without ReferenceError and all use-href references resolve against the embedded sprite.

User Story: As an editor, I want a button to open the public viewer URL in a new tab, so I can show stakeholders a read-only view.
Expected Behavior: Click "Веб-версия". Reads CONFIG.webAppUrl, opens baseUrl+'?viewer=1' in new tab. If no URL: status error.

User Story: As an editor, I want a diagnostics tool to verify chart rendering, so I can troubleshoot blank graphs.
Expected Behavior: Click "Диагностика" opens openChartDiagnostics dialog. Runs probes against DashboardPhase1 with mock data, reports pass/fail.

User Story: As an editor, I want feedback messages for every action, so I know what succeeded or failed.
Expected Behavior: setStatus(msg, isGood) updates #statusMessage with green/red color. Used by all editor actions.

User Story: As a viewer, I want the page to auto-load the latest archived report, so I see fresh data without clicking.
Expected Behavior: On DOMContentLoaded: gasAdapter.call('getArchiveBootstrap', [initialId|null]). Populates archive select, applies report (KPI/signals/table/charts/done/plans). Falls back to localStorage cache if available.

User Story: As a viewer, I want to choose any archived report from the dropdown, so I can browse history.
Expected Behavior: Change #archiveSelect → loadReportById → getArchivedReportWithPrevious → applyReportToDashboard. Caches result in localStorage.

User Story: As a viewer, I want ?viewer=1&id=N to open a specific report directly, so I can share links.
Expected Behavior: doGet sees viewer=1, sets template.reportId=parameter.id. Viewer.html data-initial-report-id consumed by viewer.js, passed to getArchiveBootstrap.
Test Method: Manual: open URL with id param.

User Story: As a viewer, I want offline fallback if the network drops, so I can still see the last report.
Expected Behavior: saveViewerCache stores {reportId, report, previous, savedAt} under key VIEWER_CACHE_KEY. On bootstrap network error, renderFromCacheFallback applies the cached report and prepends a warning signal.
Test Method: Manual: open viewer online, then go offline and reload.
Errors Found: BUG-002 (Medium): loadViewerCache was defined but never invoked. Cache writes were dead code — there was no offline fallback path.
Fix Applied: Added renderFromCacheFallback() and wired it into the .catch of gasAdapter.call('getArchiveBootstrap'). On failure, the last cached report is rendered and a banner signal informs the user that the data is from local cache.
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; bundle rebuilt; static review confirms cache is now read during bootstrap failures.

User Story: As a user, I want the compare period dropdowns pre-filled with archive reports, so I can pick two periods.
Expected Behavior: On archive list loaded: DashboardPhase2.populateCompareSelects(list, currentId) fills compareSelectA/B; defaults to last two reports.

User Story: As a user, I want to compare two archived reports side-by-side, so I see deltas of KPIs and MOs.
Expected Behavior: Click "Сравнить отчёты". Opens #compareOverlay with loading spinner, fetches reports via getArchivedReportsForCompare, renders 6-card KPI grid + low/high MO list.

User Story: As a user, I want a clear error if I pick periods in wrong order, so I can fix my selection.
Expected Behavior: If idA==idB: status warning. If A not earlier than B: warning "Первый период должен быть раньше второго…" rendered as compare-error.

User Story: As a user, I want to switch between low-coverage stagnant MOs and high-coverage top-dynamics MOs in the compare panel, so I see either risk or success groups.
Expected Behavior: Tabs "Низкий охват" / "Лучшая динамика" in compare-mo-mode-toggle. Uses computeLowCoverageStagnantMOs / computeHighCoverageTopDynamicsMOs (≥10 КнСК+, limit 5).
Test Method: Manual. Vitest covers analytics in tests/moAnalytics.test.js.

User Story: As a user, I want to close the compare overlay easily, so I return to the main dashboard.
Expected Behavior: Click X (#comparePanelClose), Esc key, or backdrop click. closeComparePanel removes .open, restores focus.

User Story: As a user, I want a card showing % of yearly plan with delta vs previous report, so I track progress.
Expected Behavior: #totalPercent = (fact/PLAN_YEAR)*100 X.X%. #totalPlanFact = fact / PLAN_YEAR (ru-RU). #totalPercentDelta = ±п.п. arrow vs previousTotals.
#totalKsk = totals.fact (ru-RU). #weeklyGrowth = "↑ +N за неделю". #totalGrowthDelta = delta of growth.
#totalColonPassed = colon. #colonPercent = X.X% из N positive КнСК (covPct = colon/hasDev*100). #totalColonDelta = delta count.
#totalZno = zno. Sub label "1-2 стадия". #totalZnoDelta vs previous.

User Story: As a user, I want an auto-summary of MO performance signals, so I see issues at a glance.
Expected Behavior: #signalsList shows up to 6 items from buildSignals: (1) MOs below 70% plan, (2) weekly plan %, (3) MOs below 50% colon coverage, (4) overall coverage, (5) top-3 КнСК weekly growth leaders, (6) top-3 colonoscopy growth leaders.

User Story: As a user, I want a bar chart comparing weekly plan vs actual growth, so I judge pace.
Expected Behavior: #planFactChart (Chart.js bar). Two bars: PLAN_WEEKLY vs growth. #planFactNote: "X.X% выполнения недельного плана".

User Story: As a user, I want a line chart of weekly КнСК facts vs plan, so I see the trajectory.
Expected Behavior: #trendChart (line). Reads weeks from fetchWeeksTrend + mergeReportDynamicsWeek. Empty message if no weeks. #trendNote shows last point.

User Story: As a user, I want to filter rank charts by MO population category (малая/средняя/большая), so MOs are compared in their peer group.
Expected Behavior: Three buttons in #rankPopulationGroupNav. Click/Enter/Space and ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End cycle focus and selection. renderRankCharts uses filterMosByPopulationGroup. Hint shows MO count + range. Default: средняя.
Errors Found: BUG-005 (UX): switching to a group with zero MOs (e.g. "Малая" when no small MOs exist in this report) left the previous group's rank charts visible — misleading. BUG-008 (A11Y): role=tab elements lacked keyboard arrow navigation expected by screen readers.
Fix Applied: Added clearRankChartsForEmptyGroup() and an empty-group hint message in updateRankGroupHint. Added keydown handler on #rankPopulationGroupNav supporting ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End to move focus and select tabs.
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; switching groups now either renders fresh charts or clears them with a clear status note; tab keyboard nav works.

Expected Behavior: Horizontal #top5PlanChart of 5 MOs with highest % plan in filtered group. X-axis 0-150%. Data label = (fact / plan).
Horizontal #bottom5PlanChart of 5 lowest % plan MOs with fact>0 in filtered group.
Horizontal #top5CoverageChart of 5 MOs with highest colon/hasDev*100 in filtered group. X-axis 0-100%.
Horizontal #bottom5CoverageChart of 5 MOs with lowest coverage AND hasDev>=10 in filtered group.

User Story: As a user, I want to see MOs with ≥500 КнСК tests but anomalously low positive rate, so I flag potential data/process issues.
Expected Behavior: #knskOutlierPanel hidden if no items. Lists ≤5 MOs sorted by ascending positive rate that have fact≥500 and z-score ≤ -1.5. Each item: rank, name, "на N меньше ожидаемого среднего", КнСК/КнСК+/%, expected positives, rate bar.

User Story: As a user, I want a scrollable bar chart of colon coverage % for every MO with rank labels, so I see the full ranking.
Expected Behavior: #coverageChart scrolls horizontally. Bars sorted desc by coverage. Labels "N место\nX.X%". Tooltip shows "Место N из M" + "X.X% (колоноскопий: c из d положит.)".

User Story: As a user, I want a prominent hint above the table that rows are clickable, so I discover the drilldown.
Expected Behavior: Blue box .table-interactive-callout with click icon and bold "Интерактивная таблица" + explanation.

User Story: As a user, I want a sortable summary table of all MOs with key columns, so I can scan results.
Expected Behavior: #mainTable: №, МО, План, Итого, %, Динамика, Нет откл., Есть откл., Колоноск., ЗНО. Rows sorted desc by percent. Heat-class + progress bar + growth color.

User Story: As a user, I want to filter the MO table by name, so I quickly find one MO.
Expected Behavior: #moTableSearch with 150ms debounce. Matching rows visible+clickable; others get table-row-hidden. #tableFilterHint shows "Показано N из M МО".

User Story: As a user, I want to click an MO row to see a quick analysis drawer, so I understand the MO without leaving the page.
Expected Behavior: Click or Enter/Space on tr.mo-row-clickable → DashboardPhase2.openMoDrawer with mo + previousMo. Phase2 lazy-loaded; first click waits for init and re-fires click on the row.
Errors Found: BUG-006 (UX): when Phase2 bundle was still loading, the first click on a row was wasted — the user had to click twice.
Fix Applied: Editor and Viewer once+capture handlers now await ensurePhase2Initialized and re-dispatch row.click() once the delegated handler is bound (only if the row is still in the DOM).
Retest Result: 159 tests pass; bundles rebuilt; static review confirms re-dispatch path.

User Story: As a user, I want "Сделано" and "Планы" content displayed in a panel below the table, so the report closes with narrative.
Expected Behavior: Section .info-blocks-panel after table. Two cards with sanitized HTML content + date.

User Story: As a user, I want a side drawer with MO metrics + a pie chart, so I see the MO breakdown immediately.
Expected Behavior: openMoDrawer fills 6 metric tiles with deltas vs previous report. Renders ECharts pie #moDrawerChart. Center shows total fact.
X button, backdrop click, or Esc closes. closeMoDrawer removes .open, disposes chart, restores focus.

User Story: As a user, I want a deeper analysis button in the drawer, so I see the full history.
Expected Behavior: Button "Глубокий анализ МО" in drawer body. Click closes drawer, lazy-loads MoProfile bundle, calls MoProfile.open(mo.name).

User Story: As a user, I want a full-screen profile of one MO with history table + 4 charts, so I see long-term trends.
Expected Behavior: #moProfileOverlay shows loading spinner. Fetches getMoHistoryFromArchive. Renders header (name + period + matched/total reports) + rank badges + KPI strip + 4 charts + history table + "Открыть в таблице".

User Story: As a user, I want my MO's place shown within its population group, so the comparison is fair.
Expected Behavior: renderRankBadges shows "<rank> место из <total> по % плана (<group> МО)" and same for coverage. Uses getMoPeerPool.
Table of all archived periods with Period/%/Δ%/Fact/ΔFact/Growth/Coverage/Colon/ZNO columns. Scrollable.
4 charts: percent line, fact line, coverage line, growth bar.
"Открыть в таблице" closes profile, scrolls main table to that MO row, highlights for 3 seconds.
X, backdrop click, or Esc → close().

User Story: As a user, I want a fullscreen presentation mode hiding controls, so I can show the dashboard to stakeholders.
Expected Behavior: .presentation-mode body class hides control-panel/text fields/period input/select panel/compare-controls. Press #presentationModeBtn or Esc to exit. Charts resize on toggle.
Floating #presentationExitBtn at top-right calls togglePresentationMode(false).

User Story: As a keyboard user, I want focus trapped inside modal dialogs, so I can navigate without tabbing into the background.
Expected Behavior: trapFocus binds keydown handler, cycles focus on Tab/Shift+Tab. focusFirst sets initial focus. restoreFocus returns to trigger.

User Story: As a user, I want Esc to dismiss the topmost overlay, so I can quickly exit.
Expected Behavior: keydown Esc: closes moProfile, else moDrawer, else compareOverlay, else exits presentation mode.

User Story: As a viewer of public links, I want user-typed HTML sanitized to safe tags, so XSS is impossible.
Expected Behavior: renderHtmlContent strips <script> + non-allowed tags. Only b/strong/a/ul/li/br kept. <a href> requires http(s) or mailto. Otherwise text is escaped. Period input writes use textContent.
Errors Found: Tightened in conjunction with BUG-003 fix: period input now uses textContent in both live editor and exported HTML.

User Story: As a user, I want skeleton placeholders during data load, so I know loading is in progress.
Expected Behavior: showLoadingState adds .dashboard-loading + .skeleton-pulse on 7 KPI ids, 3 signals skeleton lines, 8 table skeleton rows. hideLoadingState reverses.

User Story: As a developer, I want npm run build to produce all HTML artifacts, so clasp push deploys correctly.
Expected Behavior: build-gas.mjs writes UiTokens/UiPhase2/EditorStyles/ViewerStyles/UiKpiCards/UiIcons/VendorChartJs/VendorChartDataLabels/VendorEcharts/LibBundle/GASAdapter/DashboardPhase1/2/MoProfile/EditorPage/ViewerPage + Code.js.
Errors Found: No errors found. Confirmed bundle output after fixes.

User Story: As a developer, I want all tests green before deploy, so regressions are caught.
Expected Behavior: 19 test files / 159 tests. Coverage: kpi, moAnalytics, csvParser, dateUtils, archive, sanitize, moHistory, moPopulationGroups, build, etc.
